title: Cambridge Fair Housing Ordinance source-of-income screening protection
requirement: Landlords, sellers and rental agents may screen applicants only with a reasonable standard applied equally and uniformly to all, and may not discriminate based on source of income, including Section 8 and public benefits.
coverage_conditions: Housing discrimination provisions covering viewing or renting an apartment and terms of tenancy; exemption for 2-family dwellings when the owner lives there.

coverage_quotes: NOTE: there is an exemption for 2-family dwellings, when the owner lives there

exemptions: 2-family dwellings when the owner lives there.
penalty: Commission may levy civil fines up to $300 for each violation and seek damages, injunctive relief and other remedies.
quoted_span: Under the law, landlords, sellers and rental agents may use any reasonable standard to determine which applicants are selected, as long as that standard is applied equally and uniformly to all applicants.
